IDENT.title: Self-configurable Manufacturing Industrial Agents (SMIA): a standardized approach for digitizing manufacturing assets

A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.value: Industrial agent per IEEE 2660.1:2020: conjunction of High-Level Control (coordinating, reasoning, negotiating) and Low-Level Control (executing actions on asset).
A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.evidence_quote: which defines the industrial agent as the conjunction of two functional layers: a High-Level Control (HLC), capable of coordinating, reasoning and negotiating with other

A_DEFINITION__definition_source.evidence_quote: This vision is aligned with the IEEE 2660-1:2020 standard [9], which defines the industrial agent

A_DEFINITION__agent_term_used.evidence_quote: each asset is represented by a DT implemented as an in­ dustrial agent

A_DEFINITION__agent_entity_types.evidence_quote: the use case scenario involves the development of two distinct SMIA types, representing two transport robots and one operator

B_ARCHITECTURE__has_knowledge_base.evidence_quote: During execution, SMIA loads the CSS ontology with OWLReady2

B_ARCHITECTURE__kb_representation.evidence_quote: Capability and skill concepts are modeled as entities and relationships in knowledge graphs

B_ARCHITECTURE__decision_mechanism.evidence_quote: the current approach does not yet contemplate aspects of deliberative planning and goal-oriented reasoning

B_ARCHITECTURE__decision_scalability_dis.evidence_quote: Scalability, heterogeneous asset behaviour, and real-time network constraints were not fully explored.

B_ARCHITECTURE__has_communication_manage.evidence_quote: those dedicated to the management of agent communications within the multi-agent system

B_ARCHITECTURE__implementation_platform.evidence_quote: SMIA uses SPADE (Smart Python Agent Development Environment) as its development environment

C_MEMORY__memory_historical.evidence_quote: Each agent in SMIA is self-configured based on the AAS of the asset it represents

C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.value: AAS model (nameplate, interfaces, CSS capabilities/skills/constraints) loaded at boot; execution timeline recorded for user.
C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.evidence_quote: all recorded in an execution timeline accessible to the user

C_MEMORY__memory_realtime.evidence_quote: allows extracting specific information from the asset response using a search language

C_MEMORY__memory_scope.evidence_quote: Each asset is represented by an independent, interoperable DT

C_MEMORY__memory_update_mechanism.evidence_quote: all of which are prepared to accept a single AASX file as input

C_MEMORY__memory_requirements_stated.evidence_quote: These elements are not considered optional, but inherent to the intended engineering flow

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_protocol.evidence_quote: All the communications are realized through the proposed I4.0 lan­ guage based on FIPA-ACL.

D_COMMUNICATION__negotiation_mechanism.evidence_quote: a negotiation protocol is launched among them to determine which one is the most suitable

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_topology.evidence_quote: implemented as industrial agents communicating peer-to- peer.

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_cost_analyzed.evidence_quote: distributed negotiation between two SMIA instances required 5 messages, following the 2n+1 pattern of the coordination protocol

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_cost_metric.value: number of exchanged messages; total response time (0.034-0.098 s)
D_COMMUNICATION__comm_cost_metric.evidence_quote: runtime behaviour metrics (the number of exchanged messages and the total response time) were also recorded

E_LEARNING__learning_present.evidence_quote: to incorporate learning, diagnostic or planning logic

E_LEARNING__learning_type.evidence_quote: to incorporate learning, diagnostic or planning logic

E_LEARNING__explores_beyond_predefined_e.evidence_quote: Each agent in SMIA is self-configured based on the AAS of the asset it represents

F_DT_COUPLING__dt_present_in_work.evidence_quote: automatically generates Digital Twins –implemented as FIPA-compliant industrial agents using SPADE

F_DT_COUPLING__agent_dt_coupling.evidence_quote: each asset is represented by a DT implemented as an in­ dustrial agent

F_DT_COUPLING__dt_generation_from_agent_.evidence_quote: enables the automated genera­ tion of DTs that act as the functional and social representatives

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__validation_level.evidence_quote: The approach was validated in a simulated robotic logistics scenario

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__metrics_reported.evidence_quote: particular emphasis was placed on initial self-configuration time as the primary metric

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__baseline_compared_.evidence_quote: Bench­ marking against other frameworks, such as Eclipse BaSyx, is also essential

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__system_scale.evidence_quote: representing two transport robots and one operator

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__application_domain.evidence_quote: The simulated environment represents a robotic logistics cell

H_STANDARDS__ontology_used.value: CSS (Capability-Skill-Service) OWL ontology from CaSkade, extended as css-smia
H_STANDARDS__ontology_used.evidence_quote: It has been opted to reuse and adapt an open-source implementation of the CSS model [67]

H_STANDARDS__interoperability_claimed.evidence_quote: This allows maintaining interoperability with standard AAS-based tools, such as AASX Package Explorer or Eclipse BaSyx.

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_common_wi.evidence_quote: the operator can execute the automatic search and analysis of available SMIA agents

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.value: Automatic agent generation from CSS-enriched AAS models; no product agents or plan generation; no deliberative planning.
I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.evidence_quote: the current approach does not yet contemplate aspects of deliberative planning and goal-oriented reasoning

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__essential_componen.value: Well-formed AAS, semantic identifiers and loaded OWL ontology deemed not optional.
I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__essential_componen.evidence_quote: These elements are not considered optional, but inherent to the intended engineering flow in structured industrial environments.

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__static_vs_dynamic_.evidence_quote: each container starts its lifecycle with self-configuration based on the corresponding AAS model
